paper_title: An Elementary Proof of a Congruence by Skula and Granville
text:
\begin{lemma}
Let $p\ge 5$ be a prime, and define the harmonic numbers by
\[
H_k=\sum_{j=1}^{k}\frac{1}{j}.
\]
Then
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{p-1}\frac{H_k}{k\cdot 2^k}\equiv 0\pmod p.
\]
\end{lemma}
